mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen in each of the last four weeks (-71.1, -70.0, -69.4, -67.4) and the slope is flattening rather than reversing, so trend persistence alone puts the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean of -69.5.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved from -71.1 at t-3w to -67.4 at t-0w with four consecutive weekly gains
failure_condition: The next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is less than or equal to -69.5, meaning the four-week rising sequence stalls or reverses.

mechanism_narrative: Transit is the gate on discretionary trips: once the TRANSIT weekly mean improves past -68.0, the pool of shoppers able to reach high streets expands and pulls RETAIL_REC higher within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT weekly mean improves to better than -68.0 (currently -68.6, rising about 0.5 points per week)
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -70.4 at t-3w to -68.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT crosses -68.0 but the RETAIL_REC mean over the following two weeks is not above -67.4.

mechanism_narrative: The joint movement matters more than either series alone: retail recovery accelerates only when RESIDENTIAL drops below +22.2 while TRANSIT simultaneously improves, because that combination means people are both leaving home and travelling to destinations; if only one moves, retail stalls.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from +23.0 to +22.1 over four weeks while TRANSIT improved from -70.4 to -68.6
failure_condition: In the next two weeks, RETAIL_REC fails to exceed -67.4 during intervals where RESIDENTIAL is below +22.2 and TRANSIT is above -68.6.

mechanism_narrative: In a gradual-reopening regime, provisioning categories normalise before discretionary ones: GROCERY_PHARM has gained 7.4 points over four weeks, signalling households shifting from stockpiling to discretionary spending, which lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -28.7 at t-3w to -21.3 at t-0w, a 7.4-point gain
regime_hint: gradual reopening with RETAIL_REC still more than 60 points below baseline
failure_condition: GROCERY_PHARM gains a further 3 or more points while the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC stays at or below -69.5.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen every week (+23.0 to +22.1) as home confinement weakens; a break below +22.0 releases previously home-bound consumption and pushes RETAIL_REC above its current -67.4 level within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from +23.0 at t-3w to +22.1 at t-0w in four consecutive weekly steps
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL falls below +22.0 but the RETAIL_REC weekly mean in the following week is at or below -67.4.

mechanism_narrative: Restriction reimposition shows up first in parks: a weekly PARKS drop of more than 5 points records renewed stay-home compliance and precedes a fall in RETAIL_REC within two weeks as non-essential trips are curtailed again.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls more than 5 points week-on-week, as it did from -17.7 at t-3w to -25.6 at t-2w
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swung from -17.7 at t-3w to -25.6 at t-2w, a 7.9-point weekly fall
regime_hint: reimposition of restrictions or second-wave tightening
failure_condition: PARKS falls more than 5 points week-on-week and the RETAIL_REC mean over the following two weeks is higher than -67.4.

mechanism_narrative: When weekly GROCERY_PHARM improvement outpaces weekly TRANSIT improvement by more than 2 points, it marks defensive stockpiling rather than genuine reopening; discretionary retail footfall then dips over the following week as households stay local.
candidate_trigger: weekly GROCERY_PHARM change exceeds weekly TRANSIT change by more than 2 points (t-1w to t-0w: +4.1 vs +1.0)
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM gained 4.1 points from t-1w to t-0w while TRANSIT gained only 1.0 point
failure_condition: In weeks where GROCERY_PHARM outpaces TRANSIT by more than 2 points, RETAIL_REC is not lower than in the immediately preceding week.

mechanism_narrative: Seasonal outdoor activity absorbs discretionary spending: while PARKS holds at or above -25, leisure trips substitute toward open-air settings and away from enclosed retail, capping RETAIL_REC below its recent 28-day mean over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean stays at or above -25.0
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS held between -17.7 and -25.6 across all four weeks, above -25.0 in three of them
failure_condition: PARKS stays at or above -25.0 while the next 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds -69.5.
